0.use: cheap mechanical work: renames, formatting, boilerplate, simple tests (sub-1x multiplier)

1.use: default: features, bug fixes, tests, focused refactors (1x)

2.use: hard multi-file refactors and debugging (1x, high-end models)

3.use: architecture and last-resort escalation (premium multiplier, use sparingly)

excluded.reason: 30x multiplier; enable explicitly with /copilot:model include if you really want it

budget.note: Daily caps on what delegations may consume, in Copilot AI credits and premium requests (null = no cap). Usage is read from each session's own accounting.

contract:
# Work contract

Work ONLY inside ${cwd}.

## Operating rules
- Never push, commit, rewrite git history, or change anything outside the workspace.
- Do not touch files the task lists as out of scope.
- Run the test command named in the task before declaring the work done.
- Nobody will answer questions while you work: make reasonable assumptions and record them in the report.

## Final report (MANDATORY)
BEFORE you end your turn you MUST write the report file ${reportPath} (relative to ${cwd}). A task without a report counts as INCOMPLETE. The report contains:
- First line, exactly one of: `STATUS: COMPLETED`, `STATUS: PARTIAL`, `STATUS: BLOCKED`
- The goal, restated in one line
- Files changed (a "files" list of relative paths)
- What you did and why
- How you verified it (command run + outcome)
- If BLOCKED: what blocks you, verbatim, without inventing details
